title: End of session
summary: Retract the probe, unload the sample, and leave the covered instrument ready for the next session. Placeholder content written from general laboratory practice, not from the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Stop patterning and confirm retraction
steps.body: Use the software to confirm patterning has stopped, disable probe heating, and lift the head to the approved clearance position. Confirm retraction and heater-off status before handling the cover.

steps.title: Remove the amber cover
steps.body: With the software confirmation complete and the head visibly clear of the sample, remove the amber cover using the approved handling method and set it on a stable surface.
steps.check: The head is retracted clear of the sample and the probe heater is disabled before the cover is removed.

steps.title: Remove the sample
steps.body: No cooling wait is needed unless the stage heater was used; then wait for the stage readback to reach room temperature. Release the sample restraint, lift the sample by its edges with suitable tweezers, and put it in a labeled container without reaching beneath the probe tip.

steps.title: Refit the amber cover
steps.body: Remove loose tools and debris using the approved cleaning method, keeping clear of the probe head. Refit the amber cover securely without trapping cables, and leave the instrument idle in its approved standby state.

steps.title: Record the patterning session
steps.body: Record the sample and probe identifiers, pattern recipe, saved data location, and observed result. Note any approach failures, probe wear, or interrupted runs for the next user.
